inputs.name: Static RAM root with console and Wi-Fi tools

scenario: On one operator-reported ESP-Mosaico V1.2 sample, boot the ESP_MOSAICO_SC101IOT_WIFI kernel in normal multiuser RAM mode and attempt the selected WPA3/SAE profile with PMF required.
expected: The selected BSS passes vendor compatibility checks, SAE completes, association uses PMF, and the interface obtains an IP address for data exchange.
observed: The normal multiuser RAM boot reached the shell without the earlier null-callback panic. Vendor feature_caps was 0x31 with SAE capability enabled. The AUTH request was queued and processed for the selected candidate; vendor ext_connect returned 0, then disconnect reason 210 NO_AP_FOUND_W_COMPATIBLE_SECURITY followed. The capture contained no SAE build/parse callback evidence, completed association, IP address, or data exchange.
limits: One operator-reported V1.2 sample and RAM-only trial; this does not establish another board revision or persistent installation.
The RAM root is identified by role only; its private configuration is not part of this shared record.

Reason 210 does not identify the specific vendor compatibility check. Espressif lists an encrypted AP with an empty vendor STA-profile password as one possible cause; that branch has not been confirmed for this trial.
The capture did not show SAE callbacks or prove over-the-air SAE, completed WPA3/PMF association, IPv4, or data exchange.
WPA2-only authentication, DHCP/DNS, reconnect, roaming and sustained transfer remain unaccepted.
